feeds.title: Scottys Dog Blog
feeds.description: A blog site featuring funny dog stories, sad dog stories and interesting dog stories. The stories here represent the many personalities, quirks, and loving memories of all the authors dogs.

feeds.title: The Dog Network Blog
feeds.description: We are Matt and Stacey. The Dog Network is a community based website designed by dog owners for dog owners. You will find a blog section filled with current stories 'In the News,' product reviews and descriptions of some of our hikes and adventures.

feeds.title: Ontario SPCA and Humane Society » Dog Care
feeds.description: Read the latest news from Ontario SPCA. The Ontario SPCA's mission is to facilitate and provide for province-wide leadership on matters relating to the prevention of cruelty to animals and the promotion of animal welfare.

feeds.title: Dr. Dobias Natural Healing for Dogs Blog
feeds.description: The Dr. Peter Dobias blog focuses on holistic veterinary care and natural nutrition for dogs. Authored by Dr. Dobias, a veterinarian with extensive experience in holistic and conventional medicine, the blog provides valuable insights into natural pet health strategies, including the benefits of raw diets and natural supplements. Dr. Dobias aims to empower pet owners with knowledge to enhance their dogs' health and longevity without relying on pharmaceuticals.

feeds.title: Home Alive Dog Blog
feeds.description: The Homes Alive Dog blog offers information, tips, and techniques for bettering your dog's health and being a more informed and educated dog parent.

feeds.title: Canada Pooch Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts on high-quality dog apparel and accessories for dogs. Canada Pooch has over 5,000 dedicated retail partners and a community of satisfied pet parents that love our amazing selection of comfortable, durable, and fashionable products for all seasons.

feeds.title: Bark & Fitz Blog
feeds.description: The Bark & Fitz blog aims to be a resource for Canadian pet parents to turn to when looking for accurate, honest information with nothing but their pets' well-being in mind. We hope you will use this information alongside your veterinarian's expert knowledge to give your dog or cat their very best life. Bark & Fitz is a dedicated retailer of fine pet products with locations in Canada from coast-to-coast. As passionate animal lovers, we see cats and dogs as more than just pets; they are family members. That's why you'll find only the best available pet food and products at Bark & Fitz!

feeds.title: Therapy Dog Blog
feeds.description: Come view our therapy dog blog, stories from our research, therapy dog visits, fun things we've done like building a giant snowy Anna-Belle, and countless fun in our dog blog. A therapy dog team is made-up of a volunteer human handler and their companion dog, and both have undergone suitability screening and have passed the national therapy dog/handler test from St. John Ambulance.

feeds.title: Dogs Naturally Magazine
feeds.description: At Dogs Naturally, we are changing the world for dogs. We believe that good health doesn't come from drugs, processed foods, chemicals, and vaccines. We believe healthy food is the best form of medicine, and what we feed our dogs today directly impacts the quality of their lives tomorrow. That's our commitment we understand you, we admire you and we promise we'll give you everything we have to help your dog live the healthy, happy, and natural life he deserves.

feeds.title: Kolchak, the DIY dog
feeds.description: Kol's Notes is a delightful and informative blog run by Jodi Chick, a dedicated dog mom who blends her passion for DIY projects, dog care, and humor into engaging content. This blog not only offers practical advice on crafting homemade dog treats and natural cleaning tips but also shares personal anecdotes and lessons learned from Jodi's life with her dogs, particularly her beloved puggle, Kolchak. Jodi's experiences and creative ideas aim to help fellow dog owners create a fun, loving, and healthy environment for their pets.

feeds.title: Talent Hounds
feeds.description: Keep up with articles related to dog stories, training and health tips, videos, photos, news by following this feed. Talent Hounds started as a documentary TV series exploring the history of dogs, how their talents have evolved and the many ways that they enrich our lives.

feeds.title: Bedlam Acres Blog
feeds.description: Follow Dalmatians Random, Hazzard, Danger, Peril, and Murder on their travels and adventures. Bedlam Acres Dalmatians are one of the most versatile, athletic, and intelligent breeds and home of Canada's most titled Dalmatians.

feeds.title: Waggle Mail Blog
feeds.description: Explore information and resources to support a healthy body, healthy mind, and healthy pet-parent bond. Waggle Mail blends convenience with customization, choosing quality, trustworthy products that support your dog's age, need and breed. We are Canada's only vet-curated dog subscription box.

feeds.title: Liberty Pooch Blog
feeds.description: Check out Liberty Pooch news, events, and Helpful Tips and Tricks for pet parents! Fuelled by passion, attention to detail and a deep belief that dogs are family members too, Liberty Pooch offers a diverse list of boutique canine care services to bring joy, convenience and structure into your dog's life.

feeds.title: Pawsh Magazine Blog
feeds.description: Pawsh is a new breed of online magazine devoted to celebrating a dog-friendly lifestyle. We publish heart-melting photographs of animals and write about a life lived well with dogs.

feeds.title: The Dog Walks Me
feeds.description: I'm Adele and the hooman on the other end of Whiskey and Bourbon's leash. Over the years I've developed a hiking addiction and Vizslas. Join along in Whiskey the Vizsla's adventures in Vancouver, BC and the great PNW (Pacific North West).

feeds.title: Pets Canada » Dogs
feeds.description: We wanted to create a happy space for pet parents and pets of course. Where pet owners can come and read up about their pets. We are trying to answer all those questions that you might have about your pets and end up searching online. Find all the information you need on having dogs as pets here.

feeds.title: Redemption Paws Blog
feeds.description: Our Blog is updated with news about our company, events, available adoptions and so much more. Keep up-to-date with Redemption Paws. Redemption Paws is a Canadian federally registered charity that helps dogs who are affected by natural disasters, climate change, the canine overpopulation crisis, and other dire circumstances find their forever homes.

feeds.title: Modern Dog
feeds.description: Your guide to everything dog! Get inspired with the best ideas & solutions for a life with dogs--the coolest dog beds, toys & gear, training, wellness, dog rescue, DIYs, recipes.

feeds.title: McCann Dogs Blogs
feeds.description: Don't miss out on our expert training methods and tips. Learn from professional experts here on the blog. McCann Professional Dog Trainers, originally known as McCann vs McCann, was established in 1982 by Deb & Marti McCann. Though they are independent and strong-minded people, Marti & Deb quickly developed a program that they could agree on and the business as well as their marriage went from strength to strength. Over the last 40 years, they have helped more than 100,000 families train their dogs.

feeds.title: CommuniCanine Blog
feeds.description: CommuniCanine offers group dog training classes, dog training classes and lessons and private lessons on the Saanich Peninsula, led by Darcie Jennings and her staff. Advice, expertise, recipes and much more can be found on the blog.

feeds.title: Doggos Blogs » Pet Lifestyle
feeds.description: Doggos is Toronto's leading dog-centric events company. We believe that dog owners do not want to leave their pets at home. So, we create bold large-scale events that you can bring your pup to and host private socials for companies that love dogs. Stay in the loop with our blog! We share weekly tips and interesting information surrounding the dog community in Ontario.

feeds.title: WoofCrate Blog
feeds.description: Woofcrate is a Canadian subscription box for your dog! We deliver delicious treats, natural chews and exclusive toys. Explore our blog for dog behavior and training articles, health, food and more!
